sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Extensive global route network, a variety of onboard experiences including premium select, a comprehensive mobile application for trip management, and customer service initiatives for flight changes and cancellations.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Delta Air Lines is a major American airline offering domestic and international passenger air transportation, along with associated travel services. It provides various flight options, onboard experiences, and digital tools for managing trips.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Passenger flights (domestic and international)
premium cabin experiences (e.g.
Delta Premium Select)
flight management services via website and mobile app
travel deals
gift cards.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Variable ticket pricing based on destination, class, and demand; additional fees for baggage and certain services; premium upgrade options.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Individual leisure travelers, business travelers, groups seeking air transportation.
